Backend Software Engineer - Platform Team
Northwind Freight

About the role
We are hiring a Backend Software Engineer to build and scale the services behind our freight marketplace. You will design APIs, own services end to end, and work cross-functional with product and data teams.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate high-throughput REST APIs and microservices in Python.
- Own services in production on AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3) with strong observability.
- Improve reliability and performance of event-driven pipelines built on Kafka.
- Write well-tested code and champion CI/CD best practices.
- Mentor engineers and participate in code review.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Strong Python skills (Flask, FastAPI or Django).
- Experience with PostgreSQL and SQL query optimization.
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with AWS.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.

Nice to have
- Terraform or other infrastructure as code tools.
- Experience with Kafka or other message queues.
- Datadog or Prometheus monitoring.
